subject.title: Tool error messages surfaced to chat should include failure reason and retry confirmation

question: Should OpenClaw show redacted tool failure reasons and retry/recovery confirmations in user-visible chat by default, or keep those details internal unless an explicit verbose/trusted policy allows them?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the safe default depends on maintainer policy for channel trust, redaction, mutating side effects, and operator-facing recovery semantics.

options.title: Add redacted recovery-aware chat policy
options.body: Surface sanitized reasons and recovered notices only for allowed tools/channels and matched successful retries.

options.title: Keep details internal by default
options.body: Continue suppressing raw reasons in normal chat and rely on agent summaries, diagnostics, or full verbose mode for details.

options.title: Split failure reasons from recovery
options.body: First add a narrowly redacted reason policy, then track retry-success confirmation under the broader native recovery work.

recommendation.title: Add redacted recovery-aware chat policy
recommendation.body: Surface sanitized reasons and recovered notices only for allowed tools/channels and matched successful retries.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent payload/run ownership plus the policy nature of the decision make this the best routing candidate from the available history.
